QUOTE: "Fuzzy edges are not filtered here. This surface keeps them on purpose (`_direct_call_edges`, `symbols.py:389`)." and "Multi-hop paths go through `chain_trace` or traversal, which filters `fuzzy` edges. So the two can disagree on the same function."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the flat surface keeps fuzzy edges and traversal filters them, but it never gives the reason (a walk expands each hop, so one fuzzy edge multiplies into a wrong subtree).
